import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    input_parts = input_line.split()
    x = int(input_parts[0])
    threshold = float(input_parts[1])
    found = 0

    for i in range(x + 1):
        n = i
        numerator = -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4)
        denominator = 2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x
        computed = numerator / denominator

        if computed >= threshold:
            found = i
            break

    print(found)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
